items.known: CKV2_AWS_6 Ensure that S3 bucket has a Public Access block (resource aws_s3_bucket.data)
items.issue: S3 Bucket Publicly Accessible (No ACL / Public Access Block)
items.remediation: Add an explicit ACL of 'private' to the bucket and attach an aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block resource with block_public_acls=true, block_public_policy=true, ignore_public_acls=true, restrict_public_buckets=true.

items.known: CKV_AWS_145 Ensure that S3 buckets are encrypted with KMS by default (resource aws_s3_bucket.data)
items.remediation: Add a server_side_encryption_configuration block with sse_algorithm set to 'aws:kms' (preferred) or 'AES256', e.g.: server_side_encryption_configuration { rule { apply_server_side_encryption_by_default { sse_algorithm = "aws:kms" } } }

items.known: CKV_AWS_18 Ensure the S3 bucket has access logging enabled (resource aws_s3_bucket.data)
items.remediation: Add a logging block pointing to the aws_s3_bucket.logs bucket: logging { target_bucket = aws_s3_bucket.logs.id target_prefix = "log/" }

items.known: CKV_AWS_21 Ensure all data stored in the S3 bucket have versioning enabled (resource aws_s3_bucket.data)
items.remediation: Add a versioning block: versioning { enabled = true }
